items.headline: McGee Essay: Revisiting legacy of Red River Rivalry
items.description: Ryan McGee explains the history behind the Red River Rivalry as he describes the factors and traditions that make this rivalry run so deep.

items.headline: Dari Nowkhah offers advice to improve Sooners' offense
items.description: With the pressure high to secure a Red River Rivalry win, SEC Network's Nowkhah advises his alma mater Oklahoma with keys in order to come out on top.

items.headline: Mack Brown on Red River Rivalry: 'It's loud the whole time'
items.description: As Oklahoma and No. 1 Texas face off once again, former Longhorns' head coach Brown joins SEC This Morning and explains how the environment and atmosphere shape the rivalry game.

items.headline: George: Defense will decide OU vs No. 1 Texas, Manning is confident
items.description: ESPN's Katie George expects the Red River Rivalry to be a defensive battle, and discusses the support QB Arch Manning has received as he continues to find his rhythm.

items.headline: First time at the State Fair of Texas? Here are our tips
items.description: We polled our staff for their best tips on making the most of one of the sport's most distinctive backdrops.

items.headline: Connelly Week 6 preview: Things get real with SEC, Big Ten showdowns
items.description: With Georgia-Alabama, major challenges for Big Ten unbeatens and some Big 12 chaos, there's a lot to follow.
